desc: Implement adjacency construction and an iterative enter/exit DFS rooted at node 0, carrying parent, depth, cumulative distance, and the active lower-bound depth.
On entry, query the previous depth of `nums[node]` before updating it; set the new lower bound to `max(parent_lower_bound, previous_depth + 1)`, then restore the previous occurrence on exit.
Compute each endpoint’s special-path length from cumulative distances and the lower-bound depth, and minimize node count among equal maximum lengths.
Verify all-duplicate values, single-node paths, reversed edge orientations, branching rollback, and equal-length paths with different node counts.
Confirm O(n) time and O(n) auxiliary space and provide the final `Solution` implementation.
